a.xlink:title: --- extends: ".base" stage: build tags: - docker - build before_script: - echo "Build template before_script" - apk add --no-cache build-base git script: - echo "Default build script" artifacts: paths: - build/ expire_in: 1 hour
--- image: alpine:latest tags: - docker retry: max: 2 when: - runner_system_failure before_script: - echo "Base before_script" - apk add --no-cache curl

--- extends: ".base" stage: test tags: - docker - test before_script: - echo "Test template before_script" - apk add --no-cache python3 py3-pip script: - echo "Default test script" coverage: "/TOTAL.*\s+(\d+%)$/"
--- extends: ".build_template" variables: BUILD_TYPE: advanced OPTIMIZATION: enabled after_script: - echo "Advanced build cleanup" - rm -rf /tmp/*
--- extends: ".build_template" script: - echo "Building simple application" - mkdir -p build - echo "binary" > build/app

--- extends: ".build_template" variables: BUILD_ENV: production OPTIMIZATION_LEVEL: '3' script: - echo "Building complex application with optimizations" - echo "BUILD_ENV=$BUILD_ENV" - mkdir -p build - echo "optimized_binary" > build/app_optimized artifacts: paths: - build/ expire_in: 2 hours

--- extends: ".advanced_build" variables: BUILD_TYPE: super_advanced EXTRA_FLAGS: "--strict" script: - echo "Building with advanced template" - echo "BUILD_TYPE=$BUILD_TYPE" - echo "OPTIMIZATION=$OPTIMIZATION" - mkdir -p build - echo "advanced_binary" > build/app_advanced
--- extends: ".test_template" script: - echo "Running unit tests" - python3 -c "print('All unit tests passed')" dependencies: - build_simple
--- extends: ".test_template" script: - echo "Running integration tests" - echo "Coverage: 85.5%" coverage: "/Coverage:\s+(\d+\.\d+%)/" dependencies: - build_complex

--- extends: ".test_template" before_script: - echo "E2E specific setup - replaces template before_script" - apk add --no-cache chromium chromium-chromedriver script: - echo "Running end-to-end tests" - echo "Browser tests completed" dependencies: - build_advanced

--- extends: ".deploy_template" environment: name: staging url: https://staging.example.com only: - develop - "/^feature\/.*$/" script: - echo "Deploying to staging environment" - echo "Deployment successful"

--- extends: ".deploy_template" variables: DEPLOY_STRATEGY: blue-green HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT: '300' before_script: - echo "Production deploy setup" - apk add --no-cache openssh-client aws-cli script: - echo "Deploying to production with $DEPLOY_STRATEGY strategy" - echo "Running health checks" - echo "Production deployment successful" only: - master when: manual

--- extends: ".deploy_template" variables: DEPLOY_STRATEGY: canary CANARY_PERCENTAGE: '10' environment: name: production-canary url: https://canary.example.com script: - echo "Deploying canary release" - echo "Canary percentage: $CANARY_PERCENTAGE%" when: manual allow_failure: true
--- extends: ".build_template" retry: 0 script: - echo "Building without retry capability" - mkdir -p build - echo "no_retry_binary" > build/app_no_retry

--- extends: ".test_template" script: - echo "Running security scans" - echo "Vulnerability check passed" allow_failure: true timeout: 30m rules: - if: $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH == "master" when: always - when: manual

--- extends: ".base" stage: deploy tags: - docker - deploy before_script: - echo "Deploy template before_script" - apk add --no-cache openssh-client only: - main - master environment: name: production url: https://example.com
